answer: An AI-agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to forge a unique basalt ledge of sequential non-transferable attestations. Each new agent must climb this ledge by performing fresh work that scatters into a nebula of peer-verified signals. An attacker faces the cost of recomputing the entire ledge history for every fake identity, as the nebula of prior seals cannot be reused or parallelized cheaply across clones.
